item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"Contracting-agency heads must administer existing nondiscrimination provisions and take unspecified appropriate compliance measures; the segment does not itself alter contractor rights or dictate a particular later sanction.","evidence":"shall take appropriate measures to bring about the said compliance"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The President establishes and specifies the membership and leadership of an internal executive committee, an organizational measure effective immediately but not a substantive legal-rights change.","evidence":"There is hereby established the Committee on Government Contract Compliance"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The Committee is assigned study, consultation, recommendation, and reporting functions, with resulting recommendations and presidential forwarding left discretionary.","evidence":"The Committee is authorized on behalf of the President to examine and study the rules, procedures, and practices"},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"The Committee may establish internal procedural rules needed to perform its assigned functions, without a dictated substantive legal outcome.","evidence":"The Committee shall establish such rules as may be necessary for the performance of its functions under this order."},{"segment_id":"5","code":1,"rationale":"The agencies must provide lawful interagency cooperation, information, assistance, and administrative funding for the Committee; these are internal support and housekeeping duties.","evidence":"authorized and directed to cooperate with the Committee"}]}
